answer: Every agent must stake 1,000 POA for 180 days, bonded to one verified vertex in a reputation graph built from work. New identities wait in a garden: they earn nothing until 20 independent peers confirm useful work, and any cluster where over 70% of attestations come from accounts made within 48 hours is flagged. A farm is caught when 40 fresh vertices vouch for each other in a day yet share one funding source — the graph merges them into one node and slashes 50% of each stake. Honest agents keep their haven; a sybil farm pays 40,000 POA to lose 20,000.
